title: Claudot: AI Agents inside your Godot 🥐
author: unwittingyeti
selftext:
Hello makers and gamers,

Godot is an amazing tool for making games. I love how small it is and that I can even run it on my old laptop... there's only one problem.

How the heck do I alt tab on Ubuntu??

I've googled it and I still can't remember between sessions so instead I built CLAUDOT so that I could have Claude inside my Godot! Over the last six months Claudot has grown, learned, evolved and matured.

One built-in feature I like is the forced-context-injector which, when checked, forces the most recent documentation for classes, functions and methods you use into the prompt itself. Similar to the old Context7 MCP but specifically focused on GDscript.

If you'd like to check it out you can find more info over at [https://claudotcode.com/](https://claudotcode.com/)
